Name: Bread Bugs
Author: cozysweetpotato
Description:
(I FORGOT THE ARMORED BUGS WILL BE DOING THOSE SOON)


An infestation of bread has occurred in the valley! Traverse the mines and get rewarded with delicious bread bug goodies. 

Watch out the burnt bugs are extra dangerous!

Changes:
~Grub into dough worm
~Fly into baguette fairy
~Bug into bread bug
~Bug meat into dough ball
~Bait into bread crumbs
~Wild bait into fish bread
~Bug steak into french toast 
NEW ~sound for baguette fairy [url=https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/shimmering-object-79354/]first 5 seconds of this audio [/url](as a second download option) 

I am using the lovely Faedew reshade by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/11471909]rosenfey[/url] in my screenshots as well as Wildflower Grass Field by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty. 

[/url]This mod is part of a larger series I plan to make for cottage witches! The series will have a cozy cottagecore witchy vibe. I plan to do every monster and will release a full overhaul when complete and every monster set until individually until then ♡

Content Patcher required

I hope you enjoy this mod and thank you for your support ♡

Thank you so much again Selph, Button, Kat, and Nic for the help ♡
